rule: Yersinia enterocolitica O:3, YeO:3, serotype O:3
policy: requires explicit O:3 or YeO:3 metadata; do not infer O:3 from enterocolitica alone

rule: Yersinia enterocolitica with non-O:3 or unknown serotype
policy: explicit enterocolitica without explicit O:3 gets conservative unknown-serotype score

rule: Other Yersinia species or Yersinia genus-only metadata
policy: Yersinia genus-only metadata is not promoted to enterocolitica

rule: Other, unknown, or missing organism metadata
policy: missing metadata gets conservative floor score

rule: Yersinia enterocolitica O:3 phage or phiYeO3-12-like phage
policy: requires explicit O:3 phage or phiYeO3-12 metadata

rule: Yersinia enterocolitica phage with non-O:3 or unknown serotype
policy: explicit enterocolitica phage without explicit O:3

rule: Yersinia phage with non-enterocolitica or unknown Yersinia host
policy: explicit Yersinia phage metadata without enterocolitica host specificity

rule: Yersinia enterocolitica bacterial genome phage-like/prophage-like candidate
policy: requires enterocolitica source plus product annotation, not InterProScan alone
target context primary; docking and engineering support secondary; E7 residual only
